breaking_changes: LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY explicitly set to empty string no longer bypasses authentication; requests to API and metrics routes return 401 unless LEMONADE_API_KEY is provided (affects misconfigured installations only).
/files endpoint for multi-shard GGUF models in extra_models_dir now returns one entry per shard instead of a single aggregated entry; clients that assumed a single response may need updating.

evidence.blockers: Three P0 items: the NVIDIA driver-gating path on real hardware (d4f53e7-2) must work or an existing setup silently breaks; the empty-admin-key auth bypass fix (5440e3e-1/2/3) must be verified on a built server since it is a security vulnerability. The ctx_size=0 router bug (13ed8c9-2) is P1 — a default-configuration break for the new GGUF zero-shot router, but users can work around it by explicitly setting ctx_size.
evidence.breaking_changes: The empty LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY security fix tightens authentication — misconfigured setups with a non-empty LEMONADE_API_KEY and explicitly empty LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY will start receiving 401 where they previously had no auth requirement. The /files endpoint now lists every shard individually instead of returning one entry, which could surprise clients that iterate the response assuming a single main-file entry.
evidence.coverage: All 30 commits in the release range were reviewed. This rating covers all 28 to-dos from those reviews. No commits were omitted.
evidence.manual_testing: A human with a gfx1170 or gfx1171 GPU must verify model loading and inference (fe43f6f-1/2). The NVIDIA driver gating must be tested on a system with a missing or old NVIDIA driver to confirm the unsupported/action_required states and Vulkan fallback (d4f53e7-2). The auth bypass fix must be exercised against a built server binary (5440e3e-1/2/3). The multi-GPU monitor requires a two-or-more-GPU machine (d053087-1). The GGUF zero-shot router needs a real model through /v1/classify (13ed8c9-1) and the ctx_size=0 path (13ed8c9-2).
evidence.security: This release contains one security fix (5440e3e): empty LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY no longer bypasses auth. It was reviewed and a regression test was added. The fix must be manually verified on a built server before shipping. No other security concerns were observed in the commit reviews.
